Third-party 3D models used in Duel: Genesis (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

"Dragon Gate Inn with Neon" by daydev
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dragon-gate-inn-with-neon-6245309e652144bdb91b2d6188b18b11
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, rescaled, materials converted to URP, used as the front of the Genesis Card Shop.

"Sci-fi bar" by onerockett
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/sci-fi-bar-ab88353d0e7148eba5fc0f94853100d0
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, rescaled, materials converted to URP, used inside the Genesis Card Shop.
